title: Stainless Steel CCD DynaVap Screens (3 Pack)
description:
Stainless Steel Circumferential Compression Diffuser. AKA DynaVap screens a specially designed to hold pressure against the inside of the herb chamber. This keeps it snugly in place while still allowing good air flow through the screen.
Stainless steel CCD screens are compatible with both the titanium tip aswell as the stainless steel tip.
Included
3 x Stainless Steel CCD Screens
